items.question: Trong câu "AI dramatically changes how a BA PRODUCES work products.", từ "dramatically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AI dramatically changes how a BA PRODUCES work products.", what does "dramatically" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách kịch tính trên sân khấu
items.explanation: dramatically /drəˈmæt.ɪ.kli/ (trạng từ): mạnh mẽ, đáng kể. "Change dramatically" = thay đổi mạnh; nghĩa khác gắn với kịch (drama): một cách kịch tính.
items.explanationEn: dramatically /drəˈmæt.ɪ.kli/ (adverb): to a great degree. "Change dramatically" means change a lot; another sense, from "drama", is in a theatrical way.

items.question: Trong câu "It barely changes the core: understanding the business problem and building shared understanding among the people involved.", từ "barely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It barely changes the core: understanding the business problem and building shared understanding among the people involved.", what does "barely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: barely /ˈbeə.li/ (trạng từ): hầu như không. "Barely changes" = gần như không thay đổi; "barely enough" = vừa đủ, suýt thiếu.
items.explanationEn: barely /ˈbeə.li/ (adverb): hardly at all. "Barely changes" means hardly changes; "barely enough" means only just enough.

items.question: Trong câu "Know your organizational context — who holds authority, which departments are in conflict, which internal policies apply.", từ "department" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Know your organizational context — who holds authority, which departments are in conflict, which internal policies apply.", what does "department" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: department /dɪˈpɑːt.mənt/ (danh từ): phòng ban. "Departments in conflict" = các phòng ban mâu thuẫn nhau; "department store" = cửa hàng bách hóa.
items.explanationEn: department /dɪˈpɑːt.mənt/ (noun): a division of an organization. "Departments in conflict" are company divisions at odds; a "department store" sells many goods.

items.question: Trong câu "Converting formats — turning messy notes into structure, tables into prose and back.", từ "messy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Converting formats — turning messy notes into structure, tables into prose and back.", what does "messy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: messy /ˈmes.i/ (tính từ): lộn xộn, bừa bộn. "Messy notes" = ghi chép lộn xộn; "a messy situation" = tình huống rắc rối.
items.explanationEn: messy /ˈmes.i/ (adjective): untidy, disorganized. "Messy notes" are disorganized; "a messy situation" is complicated and unpleasant.

items.question: Trong câu "Converting formats — turning messy notes into structure, tables into prose and back.", từ "prose" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Converting formats — turning messy notes into structure, tables into prose and back.", what does "prose" (noun) mean?
options: văn xuôi, đoạn văn liền mạch
items.explanation: prose /prəʊz/ (danh từ): văn xuôi, đoạn văn liền mạch. "Turn tables into prose" = chuyển bảng thành đoạn văn viết liền; trái với poetry (thơ).
items.explanationEn: prose /prəʊz/ (noun): ordinary continuous writing. "Turn tables into prose" means rewrite them as flowing sentences; contrast with poetry.

items.question: Trong câu "Synthesising and summarising long documents, support logs, customer feedback.", từ "synthesise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Synthesising and summarising long documents, support logs, customer feedback.", what does "synthesise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: synthesise /ˈsɪn.θə.saɪz/ (động từ): tổng hợp thành ý chính. "Synthesise feedback" = tổng hợp nhiều nguồn thành kết luận; trong hóa học là tổng hợp chất. Mỹ viết: synthesize.
items.explanationEn: synthesise /ˈsɪn.θə.saɪz/ (verb): to combine into a whole. "Synthesise feedback" means combine many inputs into one picture; in chemistry it means produce a compound. US spelling: synthesize.

items.question: Trong câu "Playing devil's advocate", từ "devil's advocate" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Playing devil's advocate", what does "devil's advocate" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: someone who argues the other side
items.explanation: devil's advocate /ˌdev.əlz ˈæd.və.kət/ (cụm từ): người cố tình phản biện. "Play devil's advocate" = cố ý đưa ra ý kiến ngược để kiểm tra lập luận.
items.explanationEn: devil's advocate /ˌdev.əlz ˈæd.və.kət/ (phrase): someone who argues the other side. "Play devil's advocate" means argue the opposite on purpose to test an idea.

items.question: Trong câu "Translating and polishing language, especially useful when working with overseas customers.", từ "polish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Translating and polishing language, especially useful when working with overseas customers.", what does "polish" (verb) mean?
options: trau chuốt, chỉnh sửa cho hay
items.explanation: polish /ˈpɒl.ɪʃ/ (động từ): trau chuốt, chỉnh sửa cho hay. "Polish your writing" = trau chuốt văn bản; nghĩa đen là đánh bóng. Viết hoa "Polish" /ˈpəʊ.lɪʃ/ là "thuộc Ba Lan".
items.explanationEn: polish /ˈpɒl.ɪʃ/ (verb): to refine and improve. "Polish your writing" means refine it; literally, make a surface shine. Capitalised "Polish" /ˈpəʊ.lɪʃ/ means from Poland.

items.question: Trong câu "Translating and polishing language, especially useful when working with overseas customers.", từ "overseas" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Translating and polishing language, especially useful when working with overseas customers.", what does "overseas" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: overseas /ˌəʊ.vəˈsiːz/ (tính từ): ở nước ngoài. "Overseas customers" = khách hàng nước ngoài; trái nghĩa: domestic (trong nước).
items.explanationEn: overseas /ˌəʊ.vəˈsiːz/ (adjective): from abroad. "Overseas customers" are abroad; the opposite is "domestic".

items.question: Trong câu "Know your organizational context — who holds authority, which departments are in conflict, which internal policies apply.", từ "policy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Know your organizational context — who holds authority, which departments are in conflict, which internal policies apply.", what does "policy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: policy /ˈpɒl.ə.si/ (danh từ): chính sách, quy định. "Internal policies" = quy định nội bộ; "insurance policy" = hợp đồng bảo hiểm.
items.explanationEn: policy /ˈpɒl.ə.si/ (noun): a set of rules. "Internal policies" are company rules; an "insurance policy" is a contract of cover.

items.question: Trong câu "Observe users doing real work and notice the gap between the documented and the actual process.", từ "observe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Observe users doing real work and notice the gap between the documented and the actual process.", what does "observe" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: observe /əbˈzɜːv/ (động từ): quan sát. "Observe users" = quan sát người dùng làm việc; "observe the law" = tuân thủ luật.
items.explanationEn: observe /əbˈzɜːv/ (verb): to watch carefully. "Observe users" means watch them work; "observe the law" means obey it.

items.question: Trong câu "Observe users doing real work and notice the gap between the documented and the actual process.", từ "actual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Observe users doing real work and notice the gap between the documented and the actual process.", what does "actual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: actual /ˈæk.tʃu.əl/ (tính từ): thực tế, thật sự. Cẩn thận: "actual" = thực tế, KHÔNG phải "hiện tại" (false friend với "actuel" / "aktuell").
items.explanationEn: actual /ˈæk.tʃu.əl/ (adjective): real, existing in fact. Careful: "actual" means real, not "current" (a false friend of "actuel" in other languages).

items.question: Trong câu "Be accountable for a decision.", từ "accountable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Be accountable for a decision.", what does "accountable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accountable /əˈkaʊn.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): chịu trách nhiệm giải trình. "Be accountable for something" = chịu trách nhiệm (phải giải trình) về điều đó; danh từ: accountability.
items.explanationEn: accountable /əˈkaʊn.tə.bəl/ (adjective): answerable for results. "Be accountable for something" means you must answer for it; noun: accountability.

items.question: Trong câu "The pragmatic conclusion: AI makes the drafting far faster, but the hardest part of the craft — knowing what to ask and whom to ask — remains human.", từ "craft" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The pragmatic conclusion: AI makes the drafting far faster, but the hardest part of the craft — knowing what to ask and whom to ask — remains human.", what does "craft" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: craft /krɑːft/ (danh từ): nghề, tay nghề chuyên môn. "The craft of analysis" = nghề phân tích cần kỹ năng; "handicraft" = đồ thủ công; "aircraft" = máy bay.
items.explanationEn: craft /krɑːft/ (noun): a skilled profession. "The craft" here is a skilled trade; "handicraft" is handmade goods; "aircraft" are planes.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not use that list as-is", từ "as-is" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not use that list as-is", what does "as-is" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: as-is /æz ˈɪz/ (cụm từ): nguyên trạng, không chỉnh sửa. "Use something as-is" = dùng nguyên như vậy; "as-is process" = quy trình hiện tại (trái với to-be).
items.explanationEn: as-is /æz ˈɪz/ (phrase): unchanged, in its current form. "Use something as-is" means without changes; an "as-is process" is the current one (vs "to-be").

items.question: Trong câu "Speed rises substantially, but the final quality still depends on you.", từ "substantially" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Speed rises substantially, but the final quality still depends on you.", what does "substantially" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: substantially /səbˈstæn.ʃəl.i/ (trạng từ): đáng kể. "Rise substantially" = tăng đáng kể; tính từ: substantial.
items.explanationEn: substantially /səbˈstæn.ʃəl.i/ (adverb): by a large amount. "Rise substantially" means increase a lot; adjective: substantial.

items.question: Trong câu "This is among the highest-value applications.", từ "application" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is among the highest-value applications.", what does "application" (noun) mean?
options: cách ứng dụng, cách sử dụng
items.explanation: application /ˌæp.lɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): cách ứng dụng, cách sử dụng. "High-value application" = cách dùng mang lại nhiều giá trị; "job application" = đơn xin việc.
items.explanationEn: application /ˌæp.lɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a practical use. A "high-value application" is a very useful way to apply something; a "job application" is a request for work.

items.question: Trong câu "Summarising minutes, rewriting a passage for clarity, translating, and adjusting tone for a specific audience.", từ "passage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Summarising minutes, rewriting a passage for clarity, translating, and adjusting tone for a specific audience.", what does "passage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: passage /ˈpæs.ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): đoạn văn. "A passage of text" = một đoạn văn; "the passage of time" = thời gian trôi qua.
items.explanationEn: passage /ˈpæs.ɪdʒ/ (noun): a section of text. A "passage of text" is an extract; "the passage of time" is time going by.

items.question: Trong câu "Summarising minutes, rewriting a passage for clarity, translating, and adjusting tone for a specific audience.", từ "tone" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Summarising minutes, rewriting a passage for clarity, translating, and adjusting tone for a specific audience.", what does "tone" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tone /təʊn/ (danh từ): giọng điệu văn bản. "Adjust the tone" = chỉnh giọng văn (trang trọng, thân mật...); "tone of voice" = giọng nói.
items.explanationEn: tone /təʊn/ (noun): the attitude a text conveys. "Adjust the tone" means make the writing more formal or friendly; "tone of voice" is how something sounds.

items.question: Trong câu "Drafts get you past the blank page; challenge helps you find what you missed.", từ "blank" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Drafts get you past the blank page; challenge helps you find what you missed.", what does "blank" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: blank /blæŋk/ (tính từ): trống, chưa có gì. "The blank page" = trang giấy trắng, nỗi khó bắt đầu viết; "a blank look" = vẻ mặt ngơ ngác.
items.explanationEn: blank /blæŋk/ (adjective): empty, with nothing written. "The blank page" is the difficulty of starting to write; "a blank look" shows no understanding.

items.question: Trong câu "Summarising minutes, rewriting a passage for clarity, translating, and adjusting tone for a specific audience.", từ "audience" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Summarising minutes, rewriting a passage for clarity, translating, and adjusting tone for a specific audience.", what does "audience" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a formal meeting with a ruler
items.explanation: audience /ˈɔː.di.əns/ (danh từ): đối tượng người đọc. "A specific audience" = nhóm người đọc cụ thể (sếp, dev, khách hàng); "target audience" = đối tượng mục tiêu.
items.explanationEn: audience /ˈɔː.di.əns/ (noun): the intended readers. "A specific audience" is a particular group of readers; a "target audience" is who you aim at.

items.question: Trong câu "How teams build software is shifting, and BAs need to understand three emerging models.", từ "emerging" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How teams build software is shifting, and BAs need to understand three emerging models.", what does "emerging" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: emerging /ɪˈmɜː.dʒɪŋ/ (tính từ): mới nổi, đang hình thành. "Emerging models / markets" = mô hình / thị trường mới nổi; động từ: emerge (xuất hiện).
items.explanationEn: emerging /ɪˈmɜː.dʒɪŋ/ (adjective): newly appearing. "Emerging models / markets" are just appearing; verb: emerge.

items.question: Trong câu "Developers describe what they want in natural language and let AI generate code, then try, fix, and iterate rapidly.", từ "iterate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Developers describe what they want in natural language and let AI generate code, then try, fix, and iterate rapidly.", what does "iterate" (verb) mean?
options: lặp lại để cải tiến dần
items.explanation: iterate /ˈɪt.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): lặp lại để cải tiến dần. "Iterate rapidly" = làm nhiều vòng nhanh, mỗi vòng cải tiến; danh từ: iteration (vòng lặp).
items.explanationEn: iterate /ˈɪt.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to repeat cycles to improve. "Iterate rapidly" means go through quick improvement cycles; noun: iteration.

items.question: Trong câu "Risks: generated code can be inconsistent, hard to maintain, and nobody truly understands what it does — a new form of technical debt.", từ "inconsistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risks: generated code can be inconsistent, hard to maintain, and nobody truly understands what it does — a new form of technical debt.", what does "inconsistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inconsistent /ˌɪn.kənˈsɪs.tənt/ (tính từ): thiếu nhất quán. "Inconsistent code" = mã không nhất quán về phong cách hay logic; trái nghĩa: consistent.
items.explanationEn: inconsistent /ˌɪn.kənˈsɪs.tənt/ (adjective): not uniform or coherent. "Inconsistent code" varies in style or logic; the opposite is "consistent".

items.question: Trong câu "Risks: generated code can be inconsistent, hard to maintain, and nobody truly understands what it does — a new form of technical debt.", từ "maintain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risks: generated code can be inconsistent, hard to maintain, and nobody truly understands what it does — a new form of technical debt.", what does "maintain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (động từ): bảo trì. "Hard to maintain" = khó bảo trì; "maintain that..." = khẳng định rằng...; danh từ: maintenance.
items.explanationEn: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep in working order. "Hard to maintain" means hard to keep working; "maintain that..." means insist; noun: maintenance.

items.question: Trong câu "But do not let that prototype get pushed into production — this is the old throwaway-prototype trap at larger scale.", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But do not let that prototype get pushed into production — this is the old throwaway-prototype trap at larger scale.", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
options: cái bẫy, sai lầm dễ mắc
optionsEn: a common mistake to fall into
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): cái bẫy, sai lầm dễ mắc. "Fall into a trap" = mắc bẫy, mắc sai lầm phổ biến; nghĩa đen là bẫy thú.
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): a common mistake to fall into. "Fall into a trap" means make a well-known mistake; literally, a device for catching animals.

items.question: Trong câu "You write a sufficiently precise spec, AI generates code and tests from it, and the spec is maintained as the source of truth.", từ "sufficiently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You write a sufficiently precise spec, AI generates code and tests from it, and the spec is maintained as the source of truth.", what does "sufficiently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: sufficiently /səˈfɪʃ.ənt.li/ (trạng từ): đủ mức cần thiết. "Sufficiently precise" = đủ chính xác; tính từ: sufficient; trái nghĩa: insufficient.
items.explanationEn: sufficiently /səˈfɪʃ.ənt.li/ (adverb): enough for the purpose. "Sufficiently precise" means precise enough; adjective: sufficient; opposite: insufficient.

items.question: Trong câu "You write a sufficiently precise spec, AI generates code and tests from it, and the spec is maintained as the source of truth.", từ "source of truth" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You write a sufficiently precise spec, AI generates code and tests from it, and the spec is maintained as the source of truth.", what does "source of truth" (phrase) mean?
options: nguồn thông tin chuẩn duy nhất
items.explanation: source of truth /sɔːs əv truːθ/ (cụm từ): nguồn thông tin chuẩn duy nhất. "Single source of truth" = nơi duy nhất chứa thông tin chuẩn, mọi thứ khác dựa theo.
items.explanationEn: source of truth /sɔːs əv truːθ/ (phrase): the one authoritative reference. A "single source of truth" is the one reference everything else follows.

items.question: Trong câu "For a BA this is the most consequential model: specification quality directly determines product quality, more visibly than ever.", từ "consequential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For a BA this is the most consequential model: specification quality directly determines product quality, more visibly than ever.", what does "consequential" (adjective) mean?
options: có ảnh hưởng lớn, hệ trọng
items.explanation: consequential /ˌkɒn.sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (tính từ): có ảnh hưởng lớn, hệ trọng. "The most consequential" = có hệ quả lớn nhất; nghĩa khác: "consequential damage" = thiệt hại phát sinh.
items.explanationEn: consequential /ˌkɒn.sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (adjective): having major effects. "The most consequential" has the biggest effects; another sense: "consequential damage" results indirectly.

items.question: Trong câu "It turns classic BA skills — precise writing, covering exceptions, avoiding ambiguity — into the deciding factor rather than a nice-to-have.", từ "nice-to-have" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It turns classic BA skills — precise writing, covering exceptions, avoiding ambiguity — into the deciding factor rather than a nice-to-have.", what does "nice-to-have" (noun) mean?
options: thứ có thì tốt, không bắt buộc
items.explanation: nice-to-have /ˌnaɪs tə ˈhæv/ (danh từ): thứ có thì tốt, không bắt buộc. "Nice-to-have" = tốt nếu có nhưng không bắt buộc; đối lập "must-have". Hay dùng khi ưu tiên yêu cầu (MoSCoW).
items.explanationEn: nice-to-have /ˌnaɪs tə ˈhæv/ (noun): a useful but optional extra. A "nice-to-have" is optional; the opposite is a "must-have". Common when prioritizing requirements.

items.question: Trong câu "AI can produce plausible-sounding but entirely false information — a regulation that does not exist, an invented figure, a fictitious industry practice.", từ "plausible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AI can produce plausible-sounding but entirely false information — a regulation that does not exist, an invented figure, a fictitious industry practice.", what does "plausible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plausible /ˈplɔː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): nghe có vẻ hợp lý. "Plausible-sounding" = nghe có vẻ đúng, dù có thể sai; đây là đặc điểm của hallucination.
items.explanationEn: plausible /ˈplɔː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): seeming reasonable. "Plausible-sounding" means seeming true though it may be false; typical of hallucinations.

items.question: Trong câu "AI can produce plausible-sounding but entirely false information — a regulation that does not exist, an invented figure, a fictitious industry practice.", từ "figure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AI can produce plausible-sounding but entirely false information — a regulation that does not exist, an invented figure, a fictitious industry practice.", what does "figure" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: figure /ˈfɪɡ.ə/ (danh từ): con số, số liệu. "An invented figure" = số liệu bịa ra; "sales figures" = số liệu doanh số; "Figure 3" = hình 3.
items.explanationEn: figure /ˈfɪɡ.ə/ (noun): a number. "An invented figure" is a made-up number; "sales figures" are sales numbers; "Figure 3" is an illustration.

items.question: Trong câu "AI can produce plausible-sounding but entirely false information — a regulation that does not exist, an invented figure, a fictitious industry practice.", từ "practice" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AI can produce plausible-sounding but entirely false information — a regulation that does not exist, an invented figure, a fictitious industry practice.", what does "practice" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a usual way of doing things
items.explanation: practice /ˈpræk.tɪs/ (danh từ): thông lệ, cách làm. "Industry practice" = thông lệ ngành; "best practice" = cách làm tốt nhất; "practice makes perfect" = luyện tập.
items.explanationEn: practice /ˈpræk.tɪs/ (noun): a usual way of doing things. "Industry practice" is the usual way in a field; "best practice" is the recommended way; "practice" also means training.

items.question: Trong câu "Guard: never put AI-sourced information into a document without verifying it, especially numbers, legal requirements, and technical names.", từ "guard" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Guard: never put AI-sourced information into a document without verifying it, especially numbers, legal requirements, and technical names.", what does "guard" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: guard /ɡɑːd/ (danh từ): biện pháp phòng ngừa. "Guard against something" = đề phòng; "safeguard" = biện pháp bảo vệ; "security guard" = bảo vệ.
items.explanationEn: guard /ɡɑːd/ (noun): a protective measure. "Guard against something" means take precautions; "safeguard" is a protective measure; a "security guard" is a person.

items.question: Trong câu "Pasting requirements, customer data, or internal information into a public AI tool can breach confidentiality agreements and data regulations.", từ "confidentiality" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pasting requirements, customer data, or internal information into a public AI tool can breach confidentiality agreements and data regulations.", what does "confidentiality" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: confidentiality /ˌkɒn.fɪ.den.ʃiˈæl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính bảo mật, giữ kín. "Confidentiality agreement" (NDA) = thỏa thuận bảo mật; tính từ: confidential. Đừng nhầm với confidence.
items.explanationEn: confidentiality /ˌkɒn.fɪ.den.ʃiˈæl.ə.ti/ (noun): keeping information secret. A "confidentiality agreement" (NDA) keeps information secret; adjective: confidential. Not the same as confidence.

items.question: Trong câu "Analytical skill atrophies from disuse.", từ "atrophy" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analytical skill atrophies from disuse.", what does "atrophy" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: atrophy /ˈæt.rə.fi/ (động từ): teo đi, mai một. "Skills atrophy" = kỹ năng mai một khi không dùng; nghĩa gốc y học là cơ bắp teo lại.
items.explanationEn: atrophy /ˈæt.rə.fi/ (verb): to waste away. "Skills atrophy" means they weaken from lack of use; the medical sense is muscles wasting away.

items.question: Trong câu "Guard: for the most important parts, think it through yourself first, then ask AI to compare.", từ "think through" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Guard: for the most important parts, think it through yourself first, then ask AI to compare.", what does "think through" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: think through /θɪŋk θruː/ (cụm từ): suy nghĩ thấu đáo. "Think something through" = cân nhắc kỹ mọi khía cạnh; "think over" gần nghĩa.
items.explanationEn: think through /θɪŋk θruː/ (phrase): to consider carefully. "Think something through" means consider it fully; "think over" is similar.

items.question: Trong câu "AI tends to produce average, generic content.", từ "generic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AI tends to produce average, generic content.", what does "generic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: generic /dʒəˈner.ɪk/ (tính từ): chung chung, thiếu nét riêng. "Generic content" = nội dung chung chung; "generic drug" = thuốc gốc không nhãn hiệu. Đừng nhầm với genetic (di truyền).
items.explanationEn: generic /dʒəˈner.ɪk/ (adjective): general, lacking specifics. "Generic content" is bland and non-specific; a "generic drug" is unbranded. Do not confuse with "genetic".

items.question: Trong câu "An AI-written specification may lack precisely the distinctive details that make your system valuable.", từ "distinctive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An AI-written specification may lack precisely the distinctive details that make your system valuable.", what does "distinctive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distinctive /dɪˈstɪŋk.tɪv/ (tính từ): đặc trưng, tạo nét riêng. "Distinctive details" = chi tiết đặc trưng làm hệ thống khác biệt; gần nghĩa: unique.
items.explanationEn: distinctive /dɪˈstɪŋk.tɪv/ (adjective): characteristic, setting apart. "Distinctive details" set your system apart; similar: unique.

items.question: Trong câu "Because AI writes fluently, readers assume the content has been verified.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because AI writes fluently, readers assume the content has been verified.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): cho rằng, mặc định là. "Assume that..." = mặc định rằng; "assume responsibility" = đảm nhận trách nhiệm; danh từ: assumption.
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to take for granted. "Assume that..." means suppose without proof; "assume responsibility" means take it on; noun: assumption.

items.question: Trong câu "Fluency is not evidence of correctness.", từ "evidence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fluency is not evidence of correctness.", what does "evidence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): bằng chứng. "Evidence of X" = bằng chứng cho X; là danh từ không đếm được: "a piece of evidence".
items.explanationEn: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (noun): proof. "Evidence of X" is proof of it; uncountable: "a piece of evidence".

items.question: Trong câu "Output quality depends heavily on how you ask.", từ "heavily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Output quality depends heavily on how you ask.", what does "heavily" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: heavily /ˈhev.ɪ.li/ (trạng từ): phần lớn, rất nhiều. "Depend heavily on" = phụ thuộc rất nhiều vào; "breathe heavily" = thở nặng nhọc.
items.explanationEn: heavily /ˈhev.ɪ.li/ (adverb): to a great extent. "Depend heavily on" means rely a lot on; "breathe heavily" means breathe with effort.

items.question: Trong câu "Paste the actual notes, process description, or requirement rather than describing them generally.", từ "generally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Paste the actual notes, process description, or requirement rather than describing them generally.", what does "generally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: generally /ˈdʒen.ər.əl.i/ (trạng từ): một cách chung chung. Ở đây "describe generally" = mô tả chung chung; nghĩa thường gặp khác: "generally" = thường thì.
items.explanationEn: generally /ˈdʒen.ər.əl.i/ (adverb): in broad, vague terms. Here "describe generally" means in broad terms; another common sense is "usually".

items.question: Trong câu "That uses AI as an always-available reviewer rather than a ghostwriter.", từ "ghostwriter" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That uses AI as an always-available reviewer rather than a ghostwriter.", what does "ghostwriter" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: someone who writes for another's name
items.explanation: ghostwriter /ˈɡəʊstˌraɪ.tə/ (danh từ): người viết thuê giấu tên. "Ghostwriter" = người viết hộ mà người khác đứng tên; dùng AI để phản biện, đừng để nó viết hộ.
items.explanationEn: ghostwriter /ˈɡəʊstˌraɪ.tə/ (noun): someone who writes for another's name. A "ghostwriter" writes work credited to someone else; use AI to critique, not to write for you.

items.question: Trong câu "Parts of the job that shrink:", từ "shrink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Parts of the job that shrink:", what does "shrink" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (động từ): thu hẹp, giảm đi. "Shrink" = co lại, giảm; "shrink from a task" = né tránh. Quá khứ: shrank, shrunk.
items.explanationEn: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (verb): to become smaller. "Shrink" means get smaller; "shrink from a task" means avoid it. Past: shrank, shrunk.

items.question: Trong câu "Converting formats by hand.", từ "by hand" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Converting formats by hand.", what does "by hand" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by hand /baɪ hænd/ (cụm từ): làm thủ công. "By hand" = làm bằng tay, không tự động; "deliver by hand" = đưa tận tay.
items.explanationEn: by hand /baɪ hænd/ (phrase): manually. "By hand" means manually, not automated; "deliver by hand" means give in person.

items.question: Trong câu "Looking up basic information.", từ "look up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Looking up basic information.", what does "look up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: look up /lʊk ʌp/ (cụm từ): tra cứu. "Look up a word" = tra từ; "things are looking up" = tình hình khá lên; "look up to someone" = kính trọng.
items.explanationEn: look up /lʊk ʌp/ (phrase): to search for information. "Look up a word" means search for it; "things are looking up" means improving; "look up to" means admire.

items.question: Trong câu "As producing content gets cheap, judging which content is correct becomes relatively more expensive.", từ "judge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As producing content gets cheap, judging which content is correct becomes relatively more expensive.", what does "judge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (động từ): đánh giá, phán đoán. "Judge whether X is correct" = đánh giá X có đúng không; danh từ: judgement (khả năng phán đoán).
items.explanationEn: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (verb): to assess. "Judge whether X is correct" means assess it; noun: judgement.

items.question: Trong câu "As producing content gets cheap, judging which content is correct becomes relatively more expensive.", từ "relatively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As producing content gets cheap, judging which content is correct becomes relatively more expensive.", what does "relatively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: relatively /ˈrel.ə.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): tương đối, khi so sánh. "Relatively more expensive" = đắt hơn khi so với cái khác; tính từ: relative.
items.explanationEn: relatively /ˈrel.ə.tɪv.li/ (adverb): in comparison. "Relatively more expensive" means more expensive by comparison; adjective: relative.

items.question: Trong câu "People voice their real concerns to humans, not to tools.", từ "concern" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "People voice their real concerns to humans, not to tools.", what does "concern" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (danh từ): mối lo ngại. "Voice a concern" = nói ra mối lo; "a going concern" = doanh nghiệp đang hoạt động; "of no concern" = không liên quan.
items.explanationEn: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (noun): a worry. "Voice a concern" means say what worries you; "a going concern" is a working business.

items.question: Trong câu "Internal politics, project history, unwritten constraints.", từ "politics" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Internal politics, project history, unwritten constraints.", what does "politics" (noun) mean?
options: chuyện quyền lực, phe phái nội bộ
items.explanation: politics /ˈpɒl.ə.tɪks/ (danh từ): chuyện quyền lực, phe phái nội bộ. "Office / internal politics" = chuyện quyền lực, quan hệ phe nhóm trong công ty.
items.explanationEn: politics /ˈpɒl.ə.tɪks/ (noun): power struggles within a group. "Office politics" are the power relationships and rivalries inside a company.

items.question: Trong câu "Internal politics, project history, unwritten constraints.", từ "unwritten" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Internal politics, project history, unwritten constraints.", what does "unwritten" (adjective) mean?
options: ngầm hiểu, không ghi thành văn
items.explanation: unwritten /ʌnˈrɪt.ən/ (tính từ): ngầm hiểu, không ghi thành văn. "Unwritten rule" = luật bất thành văn, ai cũng ngầm hiểu.
items.explanationEn: unwritten /ʌnˈrɪt.ən/ (adjective): understood but never recorded. An "unwritten rule" is understood by everyone without being recorded.

items.question: Trong câu "Internal politics, project history, unwritten constraints.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Internal politics, project history, unwritten constraints.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc, giới hạn. "Constraints" = ràng buộc (thời gian, ngân sách, kỹ thuật); động từ: constrain.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limit or restriction. "Constraints" are limits such as time, budget or technology; verb: constrain.

items.question: Trong câu "Somebody must stand behind a decision, and that cannot be a tool.", từ "stand behind" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Somebody must stand behind a decision, and that cannot be a tool.", what does "stand behind" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: stand behind /stænd bɪˈhaɪnd/ (cụm từ): đứng ra chịu trách nhiệm. "Stand behind a decision / product" = đứng ra bảo đảm, chịu trách nhiệm.
items.explanationEn: stand behind /stænd bɪˈhaɪnd/ (phrase): to take responsibility for. "Stand behind a decision / product" means vouch for it and take responsibility.

items.question: Trong câu "A useful framing: AI makes a good BA far more effective, but it does not turn someone who does not know what to ask into a BA.", từ "framing" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A useful framing: AI makes a good BA far more effective, but it does not turn someone who does not know what to ask into a BA.", what does "framing" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: putting a picture in a frame
a way of presenting an issue
items.explanation: framing /ˈfreɪ.mɪŋ/ (danh từ): cách nhìn nhận vấn đề. "A useful framing" = một cách đặt vấn đề hữu ích; "frame someone" = gài bẫy đổ tội cho ai.
items.explanationEn: framing /ˈfreɪ.mɪŋ/ (noun): a way of presenting an issue. "A useful framing" is a helpful way to present an idea; "frame someone" means make them look guilty.

items.question: Trong câu "A useful framing: AI makes a good BA far more effective, but it does not turn someone who does not know what to ask into a BA.", từ "effective" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A useful framing: AI makes a good BA far more effective, but it does not turn someone who does not know what to ask into a BA.", what does "effective" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: effective /ɪˈfek.tɪv/ (tính từ): hiệu quả, làm việc tốt. "Far more effective" = hiệu quả hơn nhiều; "effective from 1 May" = có hiệu lực từ 1/5. Gần: efficient (ít lãng phí).
items.explanationEn: effective /ɪˈfek.tɪv/ (adjective): producing good results. "Far more effective" means much better at getting results; "effective from 1 May" means in force. Compare: efficient.

items.question: Trong câu "It amplifies existing capability rather than creating new capability.", từ "amplify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It amplifies existing capability rather than creating new capability.", what does "amplify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: amplify /ˈæm.plɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): khuếch đại, tăng cường. "Amplify capability" = khuếch đại năng lực sẵn có; "amplifier" = bộ khuếch đại âm thanh.
items.explanationEn: amplify /ˈæm.plɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to make stronger. "Amplify capability" means strengthen what exists; an "amplifier" boosts sound.

items.question: Trong câu "It amplifies existing capability rather than creating new capability.", từ "capability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It amplifies existing capability rather than creating new capability.", what does "capability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): năng lực, khả năng. "Existing capability" = năng lực sẵn có; tính từ: capable. Đừng nhầm với capacity (sức chứa).
items.explanationEn: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): ability to do something. "Existing capability" is ability you already have; adjective: capable. Not the same as capacity.

items.question: Trong câu "Never put AI-sourced information into a document unverified, especially numbers and legal requirements.", từ "unverified" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Never put AI-sourced information into a document unverified, especially numbers and legal requirements.", what does "unverified" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unverified /ʌnˈver.ɪ.faɪd/ (tính từ): chưa được kiểm chứng. "Unverified information" = thông tin chưa kiểm chứng; động từ: verify.
items.explanationEn: unverified /ʌnˈver.ɪ.faɪd/ (adjective): not checked for truth. "Unverified information" has not been checked; verb: verify.

items.question: Trong câu "The main risks are hallucination, data leakage, loss of thinking depth, and misplaced trust", từ "hallucination" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The main risks are hallucination, data leakage, loss of thinking depth, and misplaced trust", what does "hallucination" (noun) mean?
options: AI bịa ra thông tin sai
items.explanation: hallucination /həˌluː.sɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): AI bịa ra thông tin sai. Với AI, "hallucination" = tạo ra thông tin nghe hợp lý nhưng sai; nghĩa gốc là ảo giác.
items.explanationEn: hallucination /həˌluː.sɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (noun): AI inventing false facts. For AI, "hallucination" means producing plausible but false content; the original sense is seeing things that are not there.

items.question: Trong câu "The main risks are hallucination, data leakage, loss of thinking depth, and misplaced trust", từ "leakage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The main risks are hallucination, data leakage, loss of thinking depth, and misplaced trust", what does "leakage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: leakage /ˈliː.kɪdʒ/ (danh từ): sự rò rỉ. "Data leakage" = rò rỉ dữ liệu ra ngoài; động từ: leak.
items.explanationEn: leakage /ˈliː.kɪdʒ/ (noun): escaping or leaking out. "Data leakage" is data escaping to where it should not be; verb: leak.

items.question: Trong câu "The main risks are hallucination, data leakage, loss of thinking depth, and misplaced trust", từ "misplaced" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The main risks are hallucination, data leakage, loss of thinking depth, and misplaced trust", what does "misplaced" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: misplaced /ˌmɪsˈpleɪst/ (tính từ): đặt sai chỗ, không đáng. "Misplaced trust" = tin nhầm chỗ; "misplace my keys" = để thất lạc chìa khóa.
items.explanationEn: misplaced /ˌmɪsˈpleɪst/ (adjective): given to the wrong thing. "Misplaced trust" is trust that is not deserved; "misplace my keys" means lose them.

items.question: Trong câu "all raise the value of precise specification and correct validation.", từ "validation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "all raise the value of precise specification and correct validation.", what does "validation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: validation /ˌvæl.ɪˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự xác nhận là đúng. "Validation" = kiểm tra xác nhận đúng nhu cầu; trong tâm lý, "seek validation" = tìm sự công nhận.
items.explanationEn: validation /ˌvæl.ɪˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): confirming that something is right. "Validation" confirms something meets the real need; in psychology, "seek validation" means want approval.
